1.consolidated_definition: Fallo eléctrico o mecánico; en una persona, fallo físico o mental, cese de su funcionamiento normal. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. En Puerto Rico las mentiras son fecas, en los teclados se taipea y cuando a alguien le da un patatús ante tanta patada al diccionario, se dice que ha quedado craqueao o que le ha dado un breakdown (Banderillas, consultado 20-11-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Electrical or mechanical failure; in a person, physical or mental impairment, cessation of normal functioning.

Note: The term "craqueao" is a colloquialism used in Puerto Rico to describe someone who has been shocked or stunned by a series of blows or setbacks.
The phrase "le ha dado un patatús" is an idiomatic expression meaning that someone has been knocked out or rendered unconscious, often due to shock or surprise.
A "breakdown" refers to a complete failure or collapse of something, such as a machine or a person's mental state.

Electrical or mechanical failure; in a person, physical or mental impairment, cessation of normal functioning.
